text: A hand saw cuts on the push stroke. Let the saw do the work.
A miter box holds the saw straight so your cut comes out square.
Clamp the board or hold it firmly against the back of the box.
Keep your holding hand far from the saw blade.

tip.text: If the board wiggles, clamp it. Never hold a short piece near the blade.

text: Start the cut with a few slow pull strokes to make a groove.

tip.text: Cut on the waste side of your line so the board stays the right length.
